verdict.rationale: Highnote's issuing docs say only that it can create and manage tokenized digital cards. Nothing in the pack shows per-card token listing, wallet or merchant attribution, or token-level revocation separate from the PAN. The Secure Inputs tokenization SDK is an acquiring-side payment-method feature, not network-token management, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: API to list network tokens per card, wallet/token-requestor or merchant identification, independent token suspend/revoke lifecycle, token lifecycle webhooks, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, network tokens are first-class — I can see and manage the tokens created for a card, know which wallet or merchant holds them, and revoke them independently of the PAN

citations.quote: Create and manage customizable payment cards, including virtual, physical, and tokenized digital cards.
